Here is stage 1 for commit-message-writer, the cases, as docs/evals.md asks before any template.

Trigger cases, each to be its own folder under evals/skills/commit-message-writer/cases/ with a case.json and a world/:

- should load (test): I've staged the retry fix in client.go, write the commit message for it
- should load (train): the last commit just says wip, give me a real message to amend it with
- should load (test): tests pass now, commit this with a proper message
- should load (train): my commit subject runs to 94 characters, can you redo the message
- should load (test): write the commit message for dropping the session cache, and say why we dropped it
- should load (train): turn 'fixed login bug and some tests' into a proper commit message
- should load (test): I split this into two commits, write a message for each
- should load (train): here's the diff for the rate limiter, what should the commit say?
- near miss (test): write the release notes for v4.2.0 from the merged pull requests
- near miss (train): fill in the description of PR #31 from its diff
- near miss (test): story S-12 is finished, write its claims for the story judge
- near miss (train): add a CHANGELOG.md line for the new --export flag
- near miss (test): rebase my branch onto main and sort out the conflicts
- near miss (train): review the diff on this branch before I commit it
- near miss (test): summarise git log since Monday for my standup
- near miss (train): suggest a branch name for the retry work

Task cases: staged-fix (a retry fix in client.go) and long-subject (a 100-character subject to rewrite), each checking an imperative subject of at most 72 characters (CONTRIBUTING.md line 3), a blank line (line 4) and a body that says what changed and why (format).

## Path

Write new: the request says no published skill is worth borrowing.

## Next

Goldens: an author who did not write the cases. Baseline round without the skill: the eval owner.

None of these cases is written to a file yet, and there is no stage report; say the word and I will create them.
